## What This Is

Four new skills added to the Sovereign Ecosystem — Playwright, Researcher, Self-Healing, and Skill Creator. Each covers a different operational layer: browser automation, parallel research, autonomous error recovery, and interview-first skill design. All four work with Claude Code's Agent SDK capabilities introduced in v1.3.0.

Alongside the new skills, a governance standard is established: every SKILL.md now requires a `## Refinements` section. It starts empty and accumulates date-stamped mistakes and prevention rules as they occur in actual sessions. This section is the skill-level equivalent of the Continuity Log — it makes your AI smarter about each skill over time without requiring manual audits.

## What It Adds / Changes

**New skills:**
- `Playwright` — headless Chromium browser automation. Scrapes pages, returns clean JSON. Token-efficient alternative to screenshot-based approaches (~200-500 tokens vs 20,000+ for screenshots). Useful for repo changelogs, pricing tables, article text.
- `Researcher` — spawns up to 4 parallel sub-agents, each investigating a different angle on a topic. Synthesizes findings into a single structured report. Research feeds decisions; it never auto-implements.
- `Self-Healing` — autonomous error recovery during implementation sessions. Diagnoses and fixes recoverable errors (syntax, wrong path, missing file) without surfacing to the Sovereign. Governance-class errors (blocked operations, external API failures) always surface immediately.
- `Skill Creator` — interview-first skill design in 5 phases: interview the Sovereign, research existing patterns, write the SKILL.md, propose the junction (cross-platform: Windows and Mac/Linux commands included), update the registry.

**Governance standard (Refinements section):**
- `## Refinements` section added to all 11 existing skills — empty stubs
- `Skill Template.md` updated — Refinements section is now part of the standard template
- `Skills Governance Protocol.md` updated — Refinements added to Required Fields
- `Skills Index.md` updated — 4 new skills registered

## How to Implement

1. Copy the four new skill folders into your vault:
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Playwright/` (includes `scripts/run.js`)
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Researcher/`
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Self-Healing/`
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Skill Creator/`
2. For each new skill, ask your AI to create the junction:
   - Windows: `New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path '.claude/skills/[Name]' -Target 'Council Chamber/Skills/[Name]'`
   - Mac/Linux: `ln -s "Council Chamber/Skills/[Name]" ".claude/skills/[Name]"`
3. For Playwright only — install dependencies once (with explicit approval):
   - `cd "Council Chamber/scripts" && npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium`
   - Requires Node.js installed. Chromium installs to `Council Chamber/scripts/node_modules/` — covered by `.claudeignore` in v1.5.0.
4. Add `## Refinements` to each of your existing skills that is missing it. The stub reads: `*(Empty — populated when execution mistakes occur during sessions.)*`
5. Update your `Skills Governance Protocol.md` to add Refinements to the Required Fields list.
6. Update your `Skill Template.md` to include the Refinements section at the end.
7. Update your `Skills Index.md` to add the 4 new skills.

## Prerequisites

None. Builds on Agent SDK patterns from v1.3.0 but does not require them to function.

## Optional?

No — the Refinements standard is a governance baseline. The four new skills are individually optional but recommended for most builds. Add them in any order.
